description: An explicit union of one exact review response and semantic response absence, bound to a reopened pull-request observation.

go_only_rules.rule: Revision 4's Go validator requires an explicit kind while revisions 1-3 retain their omitted review_response wire image. A review_response requires batch_id and summary. A no_response forbids batch_id, summary, and replies.

A review_response is authorized only by the exact completed review_batch in the reopened primary pull-request/v1 subject. Every reply thread must be authorized by that batch. Every non-review trigger derives no_response instead.
Batch and thread identifiers are at most 256 bytes and a response contains at most 512 replies.
